transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I've been doing too much lately. I just can’t seem to stop launching projects. 

Just... things like new work plans, certification schedules, upgrading the home network... messaging a bunch of old contacts. It gets pretty intense, and... I guess I kind of blow past normal limits. Usually until my wife or... or my director at work has to step in and stop me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
During these intense periods, have you ever experienced things that others didn't seem to see or hear, or felt like you had special powers or abilities?

Um... no, no special powers. But... I guess sometimes I do hear things. 

Just... really short comments. Like my name. Or... if I'm in the server room at work, sometimes in the hum of the machines I'll hear someone say 'check the logs' or... 'they know.' Even when nobody else is in there with me. It happens in my home office sometimes, too. But... yeah, just stuff like that.
Have you ever experienced periods in your life where you felt consistently low, hopeless, or lost interest in almost everything for at least two weeks?

Yeah... I guess so. 

There are stretches where I just... I don't know. I wake up feeling like a failed version of myself. Just really heavy and flat. It's hard to explain, but... even answering my wife's normal questions just feels like too much effort. So I just kind of... withdraw, I guess. It lasts for a while.
